targets.baseline_commit_message: collect-and-rank-viewer-questions: the old viewer-questions scripts, byte copies (first commit of a port)

preserve: a question is the asker's verbatim sentence; the asker line removes marks and a leading filler word
frequency is measured: other candidates at similarity 0.82 or more, labelled recurs (4+), seen-elsewhere (1+), single-sighting
answer moments: nearest 40 by bge-small, re-ranked by bge-reranker-v2-m3, kept at 0.25, 3 a question, none within 15 s of a kept one of the same clip; strong at 0.5 and similarity 0.72
ids vq-001 on, asker_line_gate null until the gate runs
allowed_deltas: bucket codes, kinds, asker overrides, inferred questions and their file and segment, the comment segment, the basis, note and bucket words and the moment buckets are the person's settings row
a forum-posts.jsonl of the forum harvest is read for comment counts as well as reddit.jsonl
picks naming unknown codes are refused; the last line is {result}
banned_substitutions: a second copy of this job in another folder
a person's bucket, code, segment, path or name written in code
_paths: The sources live in a private repository, so each is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of trillion-launch-video beside this one finds it.
